channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dragan Bender | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dragan Bender from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dragan Bender
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Dragan Bender:

“The early look is really positive. He has a good feel for the game.”

Steve Kerr on Dragan Bender, Feb 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Nikola Vujcic on Kristaps Porzingis, Dragan Bender
item.description:
Porzingis has set a new bar for lanky European prospects, but Bender and his closest mentors aren't fond of the comparisons to the Latvian superstar.

“Dragan doesn't care what scouts think of him. He doesn't like being compared to Porzingis,”

Nikola Vujcic on Kristaps Porzingis, Dragan Bender, Jun 15, 2016. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Dragan Bender
item.description:
For Draft gurus, here'sKristaps Porzingis on Dragan Bender:

“I liked what I saw. He’s kind of similar to me, long, skinny, very talented.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Dragan Bender, Oct 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.
